data.one_liner: Makes an existing Flutter screen agent-aware over AG-UI.
data.what_it_does: Tandem connects Flutter screens to AI agents using the AG-UI protocol. It allows agents to read state, call state methods with proper validation, and wait for user approvals on important actions.
use_when: You want AI agents to interact with running Flutter screens and forms.
You use AG-UI compatible backends like Google ADK, LangGraph, or Pydantic AI.
You want local on-device model support via Apple Foundation Models on iOS/macOS 26.
avoid_when: You need non-UI pure LLM client capabilities without screen integration.
You are targeting platforms without build_runner code generation support.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with existing screen states and methods.
Works with both remote AG-UI backends and experimental local Apple on-device models.
weaknesses: Experimental API that can change before 1.0.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding tandem and dev dependencies build_runner and tandem_generator, then running build_runner build.
